# State the coin flip

`customer_support.pb.ticket_triage.state_the_coin_flip` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **playbook**

> When two queues are genuinely equally plausible, choose the one with the shorter path to a diagnosis and record that it was a coin flip.

Ambiguity resolved by a stated coin flip is auditable and improvable — the pattern shows up in reassignment data and the taxonomy gets fixed. Ambiguity resolved by escalating to a lead moves the identical coin flip to a more expensive person and leaves no trace.
